feeds.title: Labor Relations Update
feeds.description: The Labor Relations Update is written by the Proskauer Rose Labor Management Group and gives updates on labor & employment issues. Our Labor-Management Relations Group, with its distinguished history of representing management in the private, not-for-profit and public spheres is in the singular position to leverage our long and unique history for all of our clients' futures.

feeds.title: Seyfarth Shaw LLP
feeds.description: Seyfarth's Blog aims to provide timely and critical labor relations information in a readily accessible format for executives, corporate in-house counsel, and labor relations and human resources professionals concerned about labor law, union organizing activity, and labor relations generally. It brings to the business community thought leadership on cutting-edge labor law and labor relations issues with the goal of providing employers with the tools necessary to reduce their potential exposure.

feeds.title: NLRA Blog
feeds.description: Our blog can help you understand your business avoid union interference, negotiate with labor unions, and even keep your business union-free. Each of our labor experts is accomplished, experienced, and maintains an encyclopedic knowledge of labor law. We are armed with the interpersonal skills needed to communicate successfully on your behalf. We are on your side. You are not alone, with National Labor Relations Advocates, your team has experts able to guide you through whatever labor-related challenges your business may face.

feeds.title: Husch Blackwell
feeds.description: Husch Blackwell has extensive experience representing clients in traditional labor law matters. Our broad client base reaches a variety of public and private industries. The expertise of our attorneys ranges beyond the more standard labor relations matters to include guidance for clients who are reorganizing, buying, or selling assets or otherwise engaging in corporate transactions that require expert planning to avoid unfavorable roadblocks for such transactions.

feeds.title: OnLabor
feeds.description: OnLabor is a blog dev­oted to workers, unions, and their politics. We in­ter­pret our sub­ject broadly to in­clude the cur­rent cri­sis in the tra­di­tional union move­ment, the new and con­tested forms of worker or­ga­ni­za­tion that are fill­ing the la­bor union gap, how work ought to be struc­tured and man­aged, how work­ers ought to be rep­re­sented and com­pen­sated, and the ap­pro­pri­ate role of gov­ern­ment.

feeds.title: Labor Relations News and Analysis
feeds.description: Labor Relations Institute is the leading full-service labor and positive employee relations management consulting firm. We help US employers earn, protect and retain their direct relationship privilege, as we have for more than 35 years. We also help leaders in unionized workplaces protect management flexibility in their labor agreements and engage their represented employees.
